title: Receiving
body: Dispatch's radio license ends at 03:00. Your permit runs to 06:00, which is where the fine print begins: THIS PERMIT DOES NOT AUTHORIZE RECEIVING. You plug in anyway, after the third task, and the channel is not empty.

outcome.text: A voice, faint, counting. Not dispatch's dispatchers. Not the day crew. Someone is counting streets, and when they reach forty-one thousand three hundred and twelve they start again.
The counting stops. A long pause. Then, very clearly, a voice you almost know: "...again, Operator?" The channel goes to static. It stays static.

choices.label: Switch it off. The permit says receiving.

outcome.text: You file the permit. The fine print is very clear. The counting continues, quietly, in the wiring.
